chartVsOsmReview.area: Terminal Contact Apron, D3 southbound lead-out
chartVsOsmReview.note: Published pushback names TWY T5; available OSM label T5 terminates north of the D3 approximate stand area. Adjacent OSM T6 is not a validated substitute. Do not change labels or build an automatic connector by snapping.
chartVsOsmReview.chartTokenTextCheck: T6 NOT FOUND on 26 Jeppesen LTFM ADC/PDC/TAXI CHARTS while T5 is present; compare source geometry before conflation.

chartVsOsmReview.note: Do not invent edges or map them to differently named OSM lines.

notes: All named OSM taxiways are enumerated, including disconnected named subsegments.
Topological junction means exact OSM shared node, NOT any crossing of two plotted lines.
Missing stand lead-out and pushback centerline geometry remain unverified; only published procedural descriptions may be shown.
Individual chart names and operational restrictions are to be checked against current AIP and NOTAM before use.
Published Jeppesen 30-9J4 pushback wording has been categorized for 19 terminal contact stand IDs, without inventing any apron connector geometry.
41 additional names appear as distinct taxiway candidates on Jeppesen ADC 30-9 but have no same-name OSM centerline. They remain CHART-ONLY until geometrically digitized and verified.
